question: Choose the sentence with no spelling error.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 3'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct sentence with no spelling error is** option 3:** *"These components can work independently."*
 
• The word **"components"** in option 3 is spelled correctly. It refers to the parts of a system or machine.
 
• Similarly, **"independently"** is also spelled correctly in option 3. It means to operate or exist separately from other things or people.

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: *'These components can work independently.'*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's analyze the other options:
 
 
• In option 1,** "componants" **is spelled incorrectly. The correct spelling is "components".
 
• In option 2, **"indepedently"** is misspelled. The correct spelling is "independently".
 
• In option 4,** "wrok"** is incorrect. The correct spelling is "work".
